Keep body proportions, anatomy, colors, saddle and identity consistent. Side/three-quarter side view, at most 370px silhouette extent in each 512px cell. Preserve true transparent alpha background, no scenery, no floor, no shadows floating outside, no gradients or black backdrop. Entire bodies visible, never cropped, six isolated figures, no figure crosses a cell boundary. No weapons, gore, wounds, frightening close-up, deity or religious imagery, logos, signatures, text, numbers or watermark.
